source_claim: The checked official Cosmic Princess Kaguya! character profile, soundtrack page, and character-PV route establish Tsukimi Yachiyo as a character in the work, but do not explicitly map the seven packet variant tags to the base identity.

checked_routes.result: Names Tsukimi Yachiyo / YACHIYO RUNAMI, gives her profile and cast, and places her in the Cosmic Princess Kaguya! work; it does not identify the seven target packet variants.
Describes official soundtrack content and Yachiyo's credited vocal performance; it does not map chibi, ex-Otogibanashi, kassen, mini, ray, Tsukuyomi, or WEGO packet tags to the base character.
Provides the official Yachiyo character PV and profile; the page does not explicitly identify the seven packet variant tags.

notes: The base-character DIRECT_HOME is separately proposed in an AUTHORITY_BATCH. This PARTIAL outcome covers only the unverified mapping of the seven target Characters to runami_yachiyo; it is not negative evidence and does not close the campaign.
